doc.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001

title: Upcoming concerts and travel
summary: She lists concerts in Israel, Toronto with Junior Mance, Montreal, colleges, Jazz Standard, Europe and New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s coming up in the future. I know you’re going to Israel you said.
Yeah. And then I’m going to do a concert in Toronto. It’s like a solo concert but it’s two of us, it’s Junior Mance doing solo and myself. And then I’ll work a week at a Montreal Bistro.

And then I start my teaching at Berklee College of Music. I go straight from Toronto there. And then I have some college dates coming up, Smith College and some of my underground New York dates and then once again the Jazz Standard and a possible tour of Europe in July. Things are starting to fill in now.
